title: Diagonal induction on (p, q) for the ballot problem
intent: Reduce the ballot problem — the probability that candidate A (p votes) is strictly ahead of B (q votes, q < p) throughout the count equals (p − q)/(p + q) — to a diagonal induction on the pair (q, p) with two base cases and one two-induction-hypothesis step, then discharge each case with a named lemma written for it.

parent.name: ballot_problem'
parent.statement:
theorem ballot_problem' :
    ∀ q p, q < p → (uniformOn (countedSequence p q) staysPositive).toReal = (p - q) / (p + q)

children.name: ballot_same
children.closed_by: rw [uniformOn_eq_zero_iff (countedSequence_finite _ _), eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem] then emptiness: a (p+1),(p+1) counted sequence has sum 0 (sum_of_mem_countedSequence) yet must have every suffix positive, contradiction via length_of_mem_countedSequence

children.name: ballot_edge
children.closed_by: rw [counted_right_zero] then uniformOn_eq_one_of (finite_singleton _) (singleton_nonempty _) and List.sum_pos over the single all-+1 list (List.eq_of_mem_replicate)

children.name: ballot_pos
children.statement:
theorem ballot_pos (p q : ℕ) :
    uniformOn (countedSequence (p + 1) (q + 1) ∩ {l | l.headI = 1}) staysPositive =
      uniformOn (countedSequence p (q + 1)) staysPositive
children.closed_by: rw [countedSequence_int_pos_counted_succ_succ, uniformOn, cond_apply list_int_measurableSet, count_injective_image List.cons_injective] then image_inter + staysPositive_cons_pos _ one_pos (prepending +1 preserves staysPositive); no q < p hypothesis needed

children.name: ballot_neg
children.statement:
theorem ballot_neg (p q : ℕ) (qp : q < p) :
    uniformOn (countedSequence (p + 1) (q + 1) ∩ {l | l.headI = 1}ᶜ) staysPositive =
      uniformOn (countedSequence (p + 1) q) staysPositive
children.closed_by: rw [countedSequence_int_neg_counted_succ_succ, uniformOn, cond_apply list_int_measurableSet, count_injective_image List.cons_injective] then image_inter + staysPositive_cons and sum_of_mem_countedSequence using qp

children.name: first_vote_pos
children.statement:
theorem first_vote_pos :
    ∀ p q,
      0 < p + q → uniformOn (countedSequence p q : Set (List ℤ)) {l | l.headI = 1} = p / (p + q)
children.closed_by: recursion on p, q with cases 0/q, p/0 and succ/succ; the succ/succ case uses counted_succ_succ, uniformOn_disjoint_union (disjoint_bits), uniformOn_eq_one_of, count_injective_image and count_countedSequence

children.name: first_vote_neg
children.statement:
theorem first_vote_neg (p q : ℕ) (h : 0 < p + q) :
    uniformOn (countedSequence p q) {l | l.headI = 1}ᶜ = q / (p + q)
children.closed_by: uniformOn_compl then first_vote_pos and ENNReal algebra (eq_sub_of_add_eq, eq_div_iff, mul_sub, mul_div_cancel, add_sub_cancel_left)

applicability.goal_shape: ∀ q p, q < p → (uniformOn (countedSequence p q) staysPositive).toReal = (p - q) / (p + q): a two-index statement over a pair ordered by a strict inequality, reduced with Nat.diag_induction
applicability.use_when: the statement is a recurrence on a pair (a, b) that steps down both coordinates together from (a + 1, b + 1) to (a + 1, b) and (a, b + 1), with easy diagonal (a = b) and edge (a = 0) base cases
applicability.avoid_when: the pair has no natural diagonal/edge closure, only one of the two induction hypotheses is needed (then ordinary single-coordinate induction is simpler), or the strict ordering q < p is not the ordering the recurrence respects

claims.claim: The parent ballot_problem' closes from its six children: the diagonal base closes by ballot_same + simp (lines 312-314), the edge base by ballot_edge + arithmetic (lines 315-319), and the step by first_vote_pos, first_vote_neg, ballot_pos, ballot_neg then field arithmetic with ring (lines 320-344).

The induction principle the proof relies on, Nat.diag_induction, has exactly the two-base-cases-plus-step shape the proof instantiates: premises diag (∀ a, motive (a+1) (a+1)) and zero_succ (∀ b, motive 0 (b+1)) and ind (∀ a b, a < b → motive (a+1) b → motive a (b+1) → motive (a+1) (b+1)).

The glue is 36 lines (309-344) assembling 6 direct lemmas, and the longest chain of file-local lemmas below the main theorem has depth 4: ballot_problem' → first_vote_neg → first_vote_pos → count_countedSequence → counted_succ_succ.

claims.claim: The mathlib authors document the induction principle in the docstring: 'Given a predicate on two naturals motive : ℕ → ℕ → Prop, motive a b is true for all a < b if motive (a + 1) (a + 1) is true for all a, motive 0 (b + 1) is true for all b and for all a < b, motive (a + 1) b is true and motive a (b + 1) is true implies motive (a + 1) (b + 1) is true.'

consequences: The move creates three obligations: a diagonal base, an edge base, and a step carrying two induction hypotheses. Both bases must close with no induction hypothesis, and the step must produce the two smaller pairs (a+1, b) and (a, b+1) from (a+1, b+1) — here the 'condition on the first vote' split. Side conditions accumulate in the step: finiteness/non-emptiness of the count spaces (countedSequence_finite, countedSequence_nonempty), positivity of the vote count (h₃), non-zero denominators (h₄, h₅, h₆) and ≠ ∞ conditions for the ENNReal.toReal_* rewrites; one missing side condition breaks the final ring. The asymmetry that ballot_neg needs q < p while ballot_pos does not is a real obligation to track.
